args.subject: Group Booking Enquiry - 10 People in June

I am organising a group stay for 10 people in June and would like to enquire about availability. Could you please let me know which dates are available, along with any group rates or booking conditions that apply?

Kind regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
